_comment: Site-specific Terraform input variables for the permanent dev install 'ris-dev'. Loaded automatically by the installer when project_name == ris-dev (see installer/ris.py load_project_config). No secrets. Explicit values only, no CORS wildcards. Jobsearch production auth stays on its dedicated pool eu-central-1_ZURSMpD2O; auth.mays-job-matcher.app is not owned by the RIS kernel pool.

_schema.project_name: must equal the directory/file name; guards against workspace/config mismatch
_schema.terraform_vars: key=value map forwarded to terraform as ordinary -var entries
